# Hyprland keyboard reference

## Launcher

| Shortcut      | Action          |
| ------------- | --------------- |
| Super + T     | Open a Terminal |
| Super + Space | Open Vicinae    |

## Windows

| Shortcut  | Action       |
| --------- | ------------ |
| Super + Q | Close window |

## Focus movement

| Shortcut      | Action             |
| ------------- | ------------------ |
| Super + Left  | Focus window left  |
| Super + Down  | Focus window down  |
| Super + Up    | Focus window up    |
| Super + Right | Focus window right |
| Super + H     | Focus window left  |
| Super + J     | Focus window down  |
| Super + K     | Focus window up    |
| Super + L     | Focus window right |

## Window movement

| Shortcut             | Action            |
| -------------------- | ----------------- |
| Super + Ctrl + Left  | Move window left  |
| Super + Ctrl + Down  | Move window down  |
| Super + Ctrl + Up    | Move window up    |
| Super + Ctrl + Right | Move window right |
| Super + Ctrl + H     | Move window left  |
| Super + Ctrl + J     | Move window down  |
| Super + Ctrl + K     | Move window up    |
| Super + Ctrl + L     | Move window right |
| Super + Left Click   | Drag window       |
| Super + Right Click  | Resize window     |

## Monitor focus

| Shortcut              | Action              |
| --------------------- | ------------------- |
| Super + Shift + Left  | Focus monitor left  |
| Super + Shift + Down  | Focus monitor down  |
| Super + Shift + Up    | Focus monitor up    |
| Super + Shift + Right | Focus monitor right |
| Super + Shift + H     | Focus monitor left  |
| Super + Shift + J     | Focus monitor down  |
| Super + Shift + K     | Focus monitor up    |
| Super + Shift + L     | Focus monitor right |

## Move window to monitor

| Shortcut                     | Action                       |
| ---------------------------- | ---------------------------- |
| Super + Shift + Ctrl + Left  | Move window to monitor left  |
| Super + Shift + Ctrl + Down  | Move window to monitor down  |
| Super + Shift + Ctrl + Up    | Move window to monitor up    |
| Super + Shift + Ctrl + Right | Move window to monitor right |
| Super + Shift + Ctrl + H     | Move window to monitor left  |
| Super + Shift + Ctrl + J     | Move window to monitor down  |
| Super + Shift + Ctrl + K     | Move window to monitor up    |
| Super + Shift + Ctrl + L     | Move window to monitor right |

## Workspace focus

| Shortcut          | Action               |
| ----------------- | -------------------- |
| Super + Page_Down | Focus workspace down |
| Super + Page_Up   | Focus workspace up   |
| Super + U         | Focus workspace down |
| Super + I         | Focus workspace up   |

## Move window to workspace

| Shortcut                 | Action                        |
| ------------------------ | ----------------------------- |
| Super + Ctrl + Page_Down | Move window to workspace down |
| Super + Ctrl + Page_Up   | Move window to workspace up   |
| Super + Ctrl + U         | Move window to workspace down |
| Super + Ctrl + I         | Move window to workspace up   |

## Workspace by index

| Shortcut         | Action                     |
| ---------------- | -------------------------- |
| Super + 1        | Focus workspace 1          |
| Super + 2        | Focus workspace 2          |
| Super + 3        | Focus workspace 3          |
| Super + 4        | Focus workspace 4          |
| Super + 5        | Focus workspace 5          |
| Super + 6        | Focus workspace 6          |
| Super + 7        | Focus workspace 7          |
| Super + 8        | Focus workspace 8          |
| Super + 9        | Focus workspace 9          |
| Super + Ctrl + 1 | Move window to workspace 1 |
| Super + Ctrl + 2 | Move window to workspace 2 |
| Super + Ctrl + 3 | Move window to workspace 3 |
| Super + Ctrl + 4 | Move window to workspace 4 |
| Super + Ctrl + 5 | Move window to workspace 5 |
| Super + Ctrl + 6 | Move window to workspace 6 |
| Super + Ctrl + 7 | Move window to workspace 7 |
| Super + Ctrl + 8 | Move window to workspace 8 |
| Super + Ctrl + 9 | Move window to workspace 9 |

## Wheel scrolling

| Shortcut                          | Action                        |
| --------------------------------- | ----------------------------- |
| Super + Wheel Down                | Focus workspace down          |
| Super + Wheel Up                  | Focus workspace up            |
| Super + Ctrl + Wheel Down         | Move window to workspace down |
| Super + Ctrl + Wheel Up           | Move window to workspace up   |
| Super + Wheel Right               | Focus window right            |
| Super + Wheel Left                | Focus window left             |
| Super + Ctrl + Wheel Right        | Move window right             |
| Super + Ctrl + Wheel Left         | Move window left              |
| Super + Shift + Wheel Down        | Focus window right            |
| Super + Shift + Wheel Up          | Focus window left             |
| Super + Ctrl + Shift + Wheel Down | Move window right             |
| Super + Ctrl + Shift + Wheel Up   | Move window left              |

## Splits

| Shortcut          | Action                 |
| ----------------- | ---------------------- |
| Super + R         | Toggle split direction |
| Super + Shift + R | Swap split sides       |

## Sizing

| Shortcut              | Action                       |
| --------------------- | ---------------------------- |
| Super + F             | Maximize window              |
| Super + Shift + F     | Fullscreen window            |
| Super + C             | Center floating window       |
| Super + Minus         | Resize window width by -10%  |
| Super + Equal         | Resize window width by +10%  |
| Super + Shift + Minus | Resize window height by -10% |
| Super + Shift + Equal | Resize window height by +10% |

## Floating / tabbed

| Shortcut             | Action                                   |
| -------------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| Super + V            | Toggle window floating                   |
| Super + Shift + V    | Switch focus between floating and tiling |
| Super + W            | Toggle tabbed group                      |
| Super + BracketLeft  | Move window left into or out of a group  |
| Super + BracketRight | Move window right into or out of a group |
| Super + Comma        | Focus previous tab                       |
| Super + Period       | Focus next tab                           |

## System

| Shortcut            | Action                               |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------ |
| Super + Escape      | Pass shortcuts to the window         |
| Super + Escape      | Stop passing shortcuts to the window |
| Super + Shift + E   | Quit                                 |
| Ctrl + Alt + Delete | Quit                                 |

## Noctalia

| Shortcut              | Action               |
| --------------------- | -------------------- |
| Super + D             | Open App Launcher    |
| Super + O             | Open Window Switcher |
| Super + S             | Take a Screenshot    |
| Super + Alt + L       | Lock the Screen      |
| XF86AudioRaiseVolume  | Raise volume         |
| XF86AudioLowerVolume  | Lower volume         |
| XF86AudioMute         | Mute volume          |
| XF86AudioMicMute      | Mute microphone      |
| XF86AudioPlay         | Play or pause media  |
| XF86AudioStop         | Stop media           |
| XF86AudioPrev         | Previous track       |
| XF86AudioNext         | Next track           |
| XF86MonBrightnessUp   | Raise brightness     |
| XF86MonBrightnessDown | Lower brightness     |

## Screenshots

| Shortcut     | Action                |
| ------------ | --------------------- |
| Print        | Screenshot a region   |
| Ctrl + Print | Screenshot the screen |
| Alt + Print  | Screenshot the window |
